lieu: office of a small company in Plateau, Abidjan, a big desk with a leather chair, a window with city view, a framed certificate without text, morning

persos.nom: the worried boss behind the desk
persos.desc: boss in his 50s, round belly, wine-red suspenders over a white-and-grey checkered shirt, gold-rimmed glasses
persos.pose: sitting behind his big desk, worried, leaning forward

persos.desc: young employee in his 20s, slim, teal blazer with a black t-shirt, small notebook in his hand
persos.pose: standing in front of the desk, calm and confident

dialogue: Tu veux mon poste maintenant, mon gars ?!
Non, patron. Votre salaire-là seulement dêh.
Et moi, je vais manger quoi ?
Vos conseils-là, patron : faut être passionné.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The boss asks, worried. The employee answers calmly. The boss panics, both hands on his desk. The employee answers very calmly and respectfully, his face clearly visible.
chute: The boss freezes with both hands on the desk. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the boss's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: small tailor shop in Adjamé, Abidjan, rolls of colorful wax fabric on shelves, a sewing machine, a mannequin, afternoon light

persos.nom: the plump aunt with her handbag
persos.desc: plump aunt in her 50s, royal-purple-and-orange boubou, a matching tall head tie, a red handbag on her arm
persos.pose: standing in front of the counter, hands on her hips, suspicious

persos.nom: the calm tailor with the tape measure
persos.desc: tailor in her 30s, mustard-and-green wax blouse, a tape measure around her neck, holding two finished dresses on hangers, one much smaller than the other
persos.pose: standing behind the counter, holding up the two dresses

dialogue: Couturière, pourquoi tu as cousu deux robes-là ?!
Pour la taille que tu m'as annoncée, Tantie.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The aunt asks, suspicious. The tailor raises the big dress. The aunt points at the tiny dress. The tailor raises the tiny dress and answers calmly and sincerely, her face clearly visible.
chute: The aunt freezes, staring at the tiny dress. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the aunt's offended face looking into the camera.

lieu: inside an old orange Abidjan gbaka minibus parked at a station in Adjamé, worn seats, colorful stickers without text, sunny afternoon through the windows

persos.desc: young bus apprentice around 18, faded yellow tank top, a money pouch on his waist, holding a 10,000 franc banknote up
persos.pose: standing at the sliding door, holding up the banknote, very excited

persos.desc: tired driver in his 50s, grey stubble, faded khaki shirt, both hands on the big steering wheel
persos.pose: sitting in the driver's seat, turned toward the apprentice, tired

dialogue: Chauffeur ! Le client a donné dix mille et il a dit garde la monnaie dêh !
Ferme tes yeux, mon petit. C'est le palu qui commence.
jeu: Nobody walks; both stay in their places for the whole video. The apprentice shouts with joy, waving the banknote. The driver answers calmly and seriously, like a doctor, his face clearly visible.
chute: The apprentice freezes and slowly looks at the banknote in his hand. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the apprentice's shocked face looking into the camera.

lieu: street food stall in Yopougon, Abidjan, a wooden bench, a big pot of sauce and rice, a small bowl of red chili, an office building at the far end of the street, midday

persos.desc: office worker in his 30s, light-grey shirt with a loosened burgundy tie, an employee badge on his chest, holding a spoon
persos.pose: sitting on the bench in the foreground, eating, surprised

persos.nom: the stall lady with the chili spoon
persos.desc: stall lady in her 40s, lime-green apron over a brown wax dress, a white head tie, holding a spoon full of red chili
persos.pose: standing behind the stall, adding chili into his plate

persos.nom: the stern boss at the end of the street
persos.desc: stern boss in his 50s, black suit, dark sunglasses, standing far away at the end of the street, small in the background
persos.pose: standing still far away in the background, looking toward the stall

dialogue: Tantie, pourquoi tu ajoutes piment ? J'ai pas demandé dêh !
Ton patron-là arrive. Faut que tes larmes aient une explication.
jeu: Nobody walks; all three stay in their places for the whole video. The boss stays still far away in the background. The office worker protests with his spoon. The stall lady keeps adding chili and answers calmly, nodding toward the far background, her face clearly visible.
chute: The office worker slowly turns his head toward the boss far away in the background. The camera slowly pushes in to a close-up of the office worker's terrified face looking into the camera.
